review_type: Independent finite manual scientific and production-path read-through; no production edits, model execution, new training, or outcome selection

scope.finding: update_social explicitly requests world.fixture(..., scope=old, phase=social). It indexes the shared all30 concept cache only with those old18 indices; all30 cached predictions are frozen, not additional social updates. Formal matrix retains all four inherited sources and three partitions without capability selection.

FocusSender constructs identical parameter modules in both modes; its seed omits mode. Receiver reset uses the same source/partition/person seed, and fixture world/action streams omit mode. Private cache is shared between conditions. Equality is a design property here; numerical evidence is provided separately by the execution auditor.

Private all endpoint agents are restored, source heads are loaded independently and frozen, and concept construction is under no_grad. Sender input consists only of frozen private-head probabilities plus identical role bits. Positions enter sampled-action reward calculation, not concept inputs. Receiver receives only detached two-token messages and the original zero local context; it does not receive private predictions or scenes.

Shared Linear(8,96)+GELU precedes optional mean pooling. SOS7 is internal; only 0..6 are communicated. Each world starts with zero LSTM h/c. Query follows the previous token; no context input feeding is added. PyTorch Linear matrix convention gives h^T W^T key, explicitly matching the fixed plan. Two-prefix generation and full 49-code enumeration use the corresponding same first-token recurrent state.

Reward is .25*(food_correct+water_correct)+.5*both, with constant baseline .5. Sender log probabilities/entropies sum two tokens; receiver terms sum two independently sampled actions. Each person averages its sender and receiver role losses by 1/2. Detached discrete messages and NumPy reward isolate agent gradients. Fresh Adam, .0007 learning rate, separate role norm-2 clipping, 2100 entropy-on then 300 off and the 2400-update paired budget agree with the plan.

Mean mode retains a one-key softmax whose bilinear task gradient is zero; equal stored parameter counts do not imply equal effective capacity. Its exported two-element effective attention is an attribution convention [.5,.5], not a learned two-key distribution. The planned contrast is multiple-key retention plus dynamic reading versus mean compression, not a pure-attention effect.

The planned primary is sequential-token greedy, same-message both-resource J on equally weighted new12 worlds, attention minus mean at update2400. Four inherited sources are the outer paired statistical unit; directions and partitions are nested, not independent replications. Native stochastic 49-code integration is a distinct auxiliary quantity.

Donors are selected from old18 only and matched on mask/photo pair. Both slot-resource assignments are retained without success filtering. Each target is averaged across its 4 old-target or 9 new-target donor pairs before equal target averaging. The 200 shared full-code bijections rename complete donor codes, splice digits, then apply the inverse before decoding. Reference rates are aggregated by matching permutation index before quantiles.

The donor assay uses experimenter-known resource identities and imposed token splicing. Its full-code-relabeling reference preserves whole-code behavior while changing fragment geometry. Its range is not a source confidence interval or a chance baseline. A high score can support useful fragment reuse under this assay, but does not demonstrate autonomous composition, syntax, or an algorithmic novelty claim.
